title: WebGPU HTML Mesh in Rust: Web Pages on a 3D Plane
description: Render HTML to a 1024×576 RGBA texture and map it onto a WebGPU plane in Rust. Learn ray-mapped input, native/WASM capture, and a 2,304-shard effect.
imageAlt: A tilted HTML Mesh page with a green Click button and button counter, rendered on a dark 3D plane beside an egui control panel.
